summary: This regulation sets limits on the total number of director seats a person can hold at the same time in listed companies. It includes rules for regular directors, independent directors, and whole-time or managing directors. Alternate directorships also count toward this limit.
points: A person must not be a director in more than eight listed entities, and not more than seven listed entities starting April 1, 2020.
A person must not serve as an independent director in more than seven listed entities.
A person serving as a whole-time director or managing director in any listed entity must serve as an independent director in not more than three listed entities.
The count for listed entities includes both companies with listed equity shares and high value debt listed entities.
Directorships held on an ex-officio basis due to a law or contract in public sector undertakings and public-private partnerships are not included in the limit.
example: Mr. Sharma is a busy business professional working with several companies in the market. He currently serves as a regular director on the boards of six different companies whose equity shares are listed on a stock exchange. Recently, Alpha Retail Limited, which is a high value debt listed entity, invited him to join its board as well. Because alternate directorships and high value debt listed entities both count toward his total limit, Mr. Sharma must carefully check his current positions to make sure accepting this new offer does not put him over the maximum allowed number of directorships permitted by the rules at this time.

terms.meaning: Companies that have issued securities which are traded on a stock exchange.
A board member who helps bring an outside, unbiased view and does not have a material relationship with the company.
A top company official who is substantially involved in the day-to-day management and running of the business.
Holding a position automatically because of holding another office or official status.

watch: People often forget that alternate directorships and high value debt listed entities count towards the total directorship limits.
